status: natural re-blocking (product-owner decision 2026-10-05). L_YARD family, derived from the S17 base painting with art/tools/derive_era.py (same camera: walk_band, actor_scale and anchors identical to S17).
note: Same camera as S17 (yard side of ZS Sokolikova 2, camera ~2.1 m on the yard asphalt looking NW at the three-storey yard facade; horizon y 380, prop foot line y 700, s(y) = (y - 380) / 635). Late October 2020, base state before E10: the linden, its grass bed, the bench and the low service wall are gone - the corner is plain patched asphalt up to the bank (only the short stub of the red pipe remains at its axis x 1382); temporary distance markings of the pickup point (a row of yellow dashes at y ~765) are painted on the asphalt below the spot where the linden stood; the basketball hoop stands where it stood in 1995. After E10 the variant S55_linden_and_wall puts back the big linden (trunk foot 620,690), its green bed, the bench and the preserved wall with the 3x4 stone panel (the cache in row 2 / column 3); D05 opens the cache (state patch S55_cache_open).
